name: Shannon Wordsworth
original_name: シャノン・ワードワーズ
source:
Shannon is a man from the States who was a part of the Mars colonizing project. 

[spoiler]He is the main antagonist and the one who pulls the strings of the events happening in the story. Also the first one to discover the power of patches and the first one to climb the stairs of evolution.[/spoiler]
